native_original.entry: Normal hardware input: calibration, entertainment menu, original game, new scenario/ruler, army dispatch, end month, battle. Isolated NAND rebuilt from a local audited FAT image. Original source image and saves unmodified. No guest code/data injection. Read-only inspection used for cursor coordinates.
native_original.observed: Below information/find controls are ruler portrait, city count, character count, year/month and city name; a strategic summary remains visible during battle.
native_original.scope: One original new-game/battle UI observation; not full campaign or physical-device verification.

original_summary.behavior: Battle terrain/status painting does not replace this strategic footer. It is the last strategic summary, not per-unit battle stats.
